title: Customer or writer confirmation notes
summary: This topic is dominated by brief confirmation statements from customers or service writers, with only a few examples clearly indicating successful guidance or an unresolved issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe customers confirming that instructions or settings worked and that functions or controls were easy to use afterward.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe confirmation that a problem remained unresolved on one side even after checking the procedure.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly terse confirmation notes without enough context to tell whether they reflect satisfaction, troubleshooting, location verification, or routine documentation.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are extremely short administrative confirmations, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The cluster mixes routine documentation, troubleshooting verification, and occasional outcome statements, so it is not a tightly focused product issue topic.
Positive and negative evidence is sparse, so concrete aspect summaries are based on only a few examples.
